rationale: The papers 'Magnesium isotope ratios in Milky Way and dwarf galaxy stars' (2607.14067), 'Coevolution of Dwarf Galaxies and Their Circumgalactic Medium Across Cosmic Time' (2412.16440), and 'The Gas-Phase Mass-Metallicity Relation of Dwarf Galaxies Across Large-Scale Environments' (2605.25557) provide new insights into the formation and evolution of dwarf galaxies, contributing substantive evidence to the question.
